tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Base video background for every frame. Always under the radial glow and blueprint grid (see `.ig-frame`).

tokens.name: night-950
tokens.usage: Vignette edge of the radial background; deepest shade. Never a text ground on its own.

tokens.name: night-glow
tokens.usage: Centre of the soft radial glow behind the headline zone.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, comparison boxes, chat screen, caption band.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Chips, user chat bubbles, anything sitting on `surface`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and inactive outlines only (1.7:1 — never the only thing carrying meaning).

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Major blueprint grid lines (128px pitch on 1920x1080).

tokens.name: grid-fine
tokens.usage: Minor blueprint grid lines (32px pitch).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `night`, `surface`, `surface-raised` (17.4 / 15.7 / 13.4:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, subtitles, spoken caption words, on all three grounds (9.3 / 8.4 / 7.1:1).

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Labels, token IDs, upcoming caption words — on `night` and `surface` only (5.5 / 5.0:1); not on `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Emphasis and warnings: the one word the narrator leans on, caution callouts, the dot in the wordmark. As text on `night`/`surface`/`surface-raised` (7.2 / 6.5 / 5.5:1). Max one orange idea per frame.

tokens.name: orange-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind orange-outlined boxes and chips.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `orange` fill (7.2:1).

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Answers and "the AI": the model's output, correct answers, AI chat bubbles, the highlight ring, the caption's current word. As text on all grounds (10.3 / 9.3 / 7.9:1).

tokens.name: cyan-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind cyan-outlined boxes, AI chat bubbles, the fill-in blank.

tokens.name: on-cyan
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `cyan` fill — the caption bar's current word (10.3:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Wrong / false / myth: the stamp, a crossed-out claim. Always with a word or ✕, never colour alone. As text on all grounds (6.3 / 5.7 / 4.8:1).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind danger elements.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Archivo Black from Google Fonts. Headlines only; sentence case; max ~6 words a line.

styles.name: headline-xl
styles.usage: Title card, big-statement card, end card. One or two lines.

styles.name: headline-sm
styles.usage: Fill-in-the-blank sentence, long headlines (3 lines max).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Box titles, Venn labels, section headers inside a frame.

styles.name: thumb
styles.usage: YouTube thumbnail text on 1280x720. 2–4 words, uppercase.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter from Google Fonts. Nothing on a 1920x1080 frame is smaller than 28px so it still reads on a phone.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Subtitles under a headline; comparison-box body.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: It writes a new answer, word by word.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Chat bubbles, secondary lines. The smallest size for a full sentence.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: It just guesses the next word.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Token IDs, progress chapter names, percentages. Floor size — never go smaller.

spacing.note: 8px base. Frames are 1920x1080; title-safe inset is safe-y × safe-x.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, chip ID offset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; label to headline.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (small), line-to-line gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between stacked blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between comparison boxes; wordmark inset.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Big separations; safe-y.

tokens.name: safe-x
tokens.usage: Left/right title-safe inset on 1920x1080. All text stays inside.

tokens.name: safe-y
tokens.usage: Top/bottom title-safe inset on 1920x1080.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small labels, blank box.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, comparison boxes, chat bubbles, caption band.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Phone mockup body, end-card video slots.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Callout pills, kicker, progress bar.

shadow.note: Neon glow = a crisp 2px edge + two soft halos. Use one glowing element per frame as the focus.

tokens.name: glow-cyan
tokens.usage: Glowing edge on AI/answer boxes, the fill-in blank, the AI bubble.

tokens.name: glow-orange
tokens.usage: Glowing edge on emphasis/warning boxes and the kicker.

tokens.name: glow-danger
tokens.usage: The stamp.

tokens.name: glow-text-cyan
tokens.usage: text-shadow for cyan words.

tokens.name: glow-text-orange
tokens.usage: text-shadow for orange words.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Drop shadow under cards and the phone so they float off the grid.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Exits, caption word steps, hover-like nudges.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Default entrance (rise, fade, pop).

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Line draws, rings, progress fill segments.

tokens.name: stagger-word
tokens.usage: Delay between chips / words entering.

tokens.name: stagger-line
tokens.usage: Delay between headline lines / cards.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default: fast start, soft landing. Rises, slides, draws.

tokens.name: ease-pop
tokens.usage: Overshoot for chips, pills, the answer landing.

tokens.name: ease-slam
tokens.usage: Accelerating hit for the stamp.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Camera-like moves, progress fill, Venn slide.
